        local HoursMul, MinutesMul, SecondsMul = 60 * 60, 60, 1

        GetValue = GetValue - (HoursMul * ResultHours)

        local ResultSeconds = GetValue
        return ResultHours, ResultMinutes, ResultSeconds
    end
